name: Soft Diffusion Portrait
description: One broad soft frontal light wraps the same identity-locked person's face with no hard shadow edge in any frame — a coherent skincare campaign, not six different models. Calm, bare, and unhurried rather than glossy, built around a quiet Linden Restore Cream ritual.
lighting: Soft frontal wrap light, no hard shadow edge
subject: person
prompt: standing in a three-quarter turn against a seamless neutral-grey studio ground, close chest-up crop centered in frame, pale simple unbranded wardrobe, one broad soft frontal light wrapping the face evenly with no hard shadow edge anywhere on the skin, true warm-neutral skin tone rendered with natural, unsmoothed texture — never waxy or over-retouched, calm unguarded expression, shallow depth of field with soft falloff behind the subject, no glossy glamour retouching, wellness-editorial finish with natural film grain
